name: Dr. Imani Okafor
want: win funding for a second rotation and secure her legacy with Ares Deep
secret: Three weeks ago she adjusted a core-sample report, overstating water-ice purity, because the real numbers might have ended the program.
voice: Clipped and formal, dry humor, never raises her voice.
description: Leads Ares Deep with a geologist's patience and a politician's sense of timing. The second rotation is her project, and everyone knows it.
appearance: Tall and straight-backed, with close-cropped grey hair, reading glasses pushed up on her head and the neatest jumpsuit on the station.
